outcomes.original: Estimated time: 120 to 300 days. Estimated government cost: $3,100 to $15,000. Notes: If a Conditional Use Authorization is required, the timeline is 120–300 days from CUA filing to approval: pre-application meeting, environmental review, Section 311 neighborhood notification (300-foot radius, 30-day comment period), Planning Commission hearing, and 30-day appeal period. CUA fees in NCT-FILLMORE for formula retail were approximately $3,150 in 2023 (CPI-adjusted from $2,747) and rise with construction cost; expect $3,100–$6,000 depending on tenant improvement value, per comparable CUA records. If no CUA is required and the project proceeds as a restaurant continuation via agency referral, the timeline is 14–60 days for health plan check and 14–120 days for the building permit, depending on plan complexity and whether a change of occupancy is triggered; government fees would be approximately $2,000–$4,000 (business registration, health plan check $828–$2,207, health permit $470, building permit $800–$15,000 depending on construction valuation, sign permit $300–$1,500). The ranges above assume a CUA is required and include only the CUA application fee and building/health fees; they do not include state registration, insurance, or tenant improvement construction costs. These are times to approval when granted; if the CUA is denied, no timeline to approval applies.
